title: MeitY Approves 29 Proposals Worth ₹7,104 Cr Under ECMS Scheme
summary: Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) approves India's 1st Tantalum SMD passive plant, 1st Flexible PCB plant, and 1st Rare Earth Magnet facility.

blocks.text: 🪝 MeitY Approves 29 Proposals Worth ₹7,104 Cr Under ECMS Scheme. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: MeitY approved 29 proposals under ECMS involving ₹7,104 crore investment for ₹84,515 crore projected production, taking total ECMS approvals to 75 applications (₹61,671 crore investment).
